items.title: Quiz Q#1001 · Raymond Carver
items.meta: Post-War, Postmodern & Contemporary Era · Raymond Carver
items.stem: Which fiction by Raymond Carver features A husband who scorns blindness and then draws a cathedral with closed eyes?
options: Will You Please Be Quiet, Please?
What We Talk About When We Talk About Love
items.explanation: A husband who scorns blindness and then draws a cathedral with closed eyes is the central figure / speaker in Raymond Carver's Cathedral (1983).

items.title: Quiz Q#1002 · Raymond Carver
items.meta: Post-War, Postmodern & Contemporary Era · Raymond Carver
items.stem: Which 1983 short-story collection by Raymond Carver marks a pivotal shift in his style, highlighted by the title story where an unnamed husband draws a cathedral with a blind guest?
options: Will You Please Be Quiet, Please?
What We Talk About When We Talk About Love
items.explanation: Raymond Carver's 'Cathedral' (1983) is a masterwork of dirty realism / minimalism, capturing a transformative moment of human connection and epiphanic vision.
